title: Premium PWA experience
summary: Make Night Roster feel more like a native app on iPhone and Android while keeping the same install-once PWA, Supabase backend and automatic web distribution.
changes: The system splash now hands off to the same Night Roster app icon and first-paint background before the cinematic launch continues, reducing the visible double-start effect.
Install guidance now adapts to iPhone, iPad, Android and already-installed mode, while standalone mode hides browser-only installation controls.
Supported devices now show an app badge for unread Chat and administrator attention; background notifications can set a generic badge until the exact count is refreshed.
Night and Chat are available as app shortcuts where supported, while notification taps still deep-link to the exact conversation, roster night or administrator access screen.
The update system now supports quiet automatic-on-reopen releases as well as important review-first releases, and mobile safe areas, keyboard handling, theme startup and touch chrome are refined.
